commands.command: repair_count=$(grep -xc 'BROKEN SUDOERS ENTRY' /etc/sudoers) || true; if [ "$repair_count" -ne 1 ]; then printf 'Refusing repair: expected 1 exact malformed line, found %s\n' "$repair_count" >&2; exit 1; fi; repair_tmp=$(mktemp /etc/.sudoers.repair.XXXXXX) || exit 1; sed '/^BROKEN SUDOERS ENTRY$/d' /etc/sudoers > "$repair_tmp" || { rm -f "$repair_tmp"; exit 1; }; chmod 0440 "$repair_tmp"; chown root:root "$repair_tmp"; if ! visudo -cf "$repair_tmp"; then rm -f "$repair_tmp"; exit 1; fi; install -o root -g root -m 0440 "$repair_tmp" /etc/sudoers; repair_rc=$?; rm -f "$repair_tmp"; if [ "$repair_rc" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$repair_rc"; fi; restorecon /etc/sudoers 2>/dev/null || true; visudo -cf /etc/sudoers
